name: Thelia Memory Entry Schema

fields.status: observed | confirmed | inferred | provisional | uncertain | contradicted | deprecated | historical
fields.raw_keys: original wording, unique terms, abbreviations, fragments, and meaningful typos used only as recall signals
fields.aliases: alternate references, pronouns, shorthand, local labels, and model-specific naming variants
fields.entities: people, projects, files, models, concepts, or other stable referents
fields.content: actual memory statement or structured payload
fields.supersedes: older memory IDs replaced in current interpretation
fields.contradicts: memory IDs that remain in tension

rules: semantic_keys summarize meaning without erasing the original wording
raw_keys preserve recall clues but are never treated as truth by themselves
meaningful typos may be stored as raw retrieval signals, not as corrected facts
aliases resolve references but do not create new facts
canonical identity properties remain outside writable memory
